messages:
Nora Kim: Scheduling a maintenance for az-core2 GPU racks Sat 00:30-03:30 UTC. Scope: rolling soft reboots + NIC sanity checks. Expect ~8-13% hit to the 'flux' shared pool. Need backfill plan + console banner.
Diego Ramos: Keep cohorts small. Suggest 3 nodes every 10m across racks to limit cross-az noise.
Priya Shah: Agreed. We'll do canary cohort at 00:30, wait 10m, run health probe. Use KV/embedding seed after each cohort.
Nora Kim: Backfill proposal: prefer preemptible for 70% burst, 30% on-demand. Cost estimate: 6 on-demand * $2.6/hr * 3h = $46.8. Tagging Finance.
Diego Ramos: Add temporary routing fallback to us-west2 for latency-sensitive routes. Note egress increase.
Priya Shah: Eviction policy: `kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=300`. Honor `infra/preserve=true` annotation.
Nora Kim: Probe command: `python infra/probes/latency_check.py --pool=flux --p=95`. Abort if 95p > 2x baseline. ops-bot should create incident if threshold hit.
ops-bot: Scheduled maintenance created: az-core2-flux-softreboot (6187654321). Window Sat 00:30-03:30 UTC. Notifications: #customers, #gpucapacity, #support.
Diego Ramos: Staging dry-run tonight 22:00 UTC. Will paste results.
Priya Shah: Runbook snippet:
```
kubectl cordon gpu-node-9
kubectl drain gpu-node-9 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=300
curl -X POST https://infra-api/internal/seed?pool=flux
python infra/probes/latency_check.py --pool=flux --p=95
```
Nora Kim: I'll post customer comms draft after Finance confirms burst. Reopen if any blockers.
